                $('#reptable tbody tr').addClass('selectedrow');
                $('#reptable2 tbody tr').addClass('selectedrow');
                $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem").prop("checked", true);
            }
            else {
                $('#reptable tbody tr').removeClass('selectedrow');
                $('#reptable2 tbody tr').removeClass('selectedrow');
                $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem").prop("checked", false);
            }

            if($(this).prop('checked')) {
                $('#reptable2 tbody tr:nth-child(' + (parseInt($(this).parent().parent().index())  + 1) + ')').addClass('selectedrow');
                $(this).parent().parent().addClass('selectedrow');
            }
            else {
                $('#reptable2 tbody tr:nth-child(' + (parseInt($(this).parent().parent().index())  + 1) + ')').removeClass('selectedrow');

            }

            $(this).parent().find('input').trigger('click');
            if(shiftpressed) {
                var index = $(this).parent().index();
                for(var i = index; i > -1; i--) {
                    if(check) {
                        if ($('#appendbody tr:nth-child(' + i + ')').find('input').prop('checked')) return false;
                        else $('#appendbody tr:nth-child(' + i + ')').find('input').trigger('click');
                    }
                    else {
                        if (!$('#appendbody tr:nth-child(' + i + ')').find('input').prop('checked')) return false;
                        else $('#appendbody tr:nth-child(' + i + ')').find('input').trigger('click');
                    }
                }
            }
        });
            
        $(document).on('click', '#qrcodes', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            var counter = 0;
            var tmprow = new Array();
            $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem:checked").each(function (key) {
                tmprow.push(this.value);
                counter++;
            });
            if (counter == 0) {
                CustomAlert("No Assets selected.", "", "warning");
                return false;
            }
            else {
                StandardDialog(this.href, "Generate QR codes (PDF) - " + counter + " asset" + (counter > 1 ? "s" : ""), function (data) {
                    var dat = JSON.parse(data);
                    if(dat.Error) {
                        CustomAlert(dat.Emsg, 'Error', 'error');
                    }
                    else {
                    window.location.href = '/QRCodes.aspx?type=' + dat[0] + '&orientation=' + dat[1] + '&document=' + dat[2] +
                                            '&color=' + dat[3] + '&papertype=' + dat[4] + '&url=' + dat[5] + '&textalign=' + dat[6] + '&titleposition=' + dat[7];
                    }
                }, "Ok", tmprow);
            }
        });

            $("#reptablehead2 th").removeClass("sorting_asc");

                th.addClass("sorting_asc");
                window.sortdir = "asc";
            }
            else{ 
                th.addClass("sorting_desc");
                 window.sortdir = "desc";
            }

        $(".assetaction").on("click", function (event) {
                
            event.preventDefault();

            var action = $(this).data('action');
            var tmprow = new Object();
            var counter = 0;
            var href = this.href;
            var hasAzureRgSelected = false;
            var hasAwsContainerSelected = false;
            
            $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem:checked").each(function (key) {
                tmprow[parseInt(this.value)] = this.name;         
                counter++;

                if ($(this).data('type') === "Azure Resource Group") {
                    hasAzureRgSelected = true;
                }
                else if ($(this).data('type') === "AWS EC2 VPC"
                    || $(this).data('type') === "AWS EC2 Classic") {
                    hasAwsContainerSelected = true;
                }
            });
                
            if (counter == 0) {
                CustomAlert("No Assets selected.", "", "warning");
                return false;
            }
            
            if (action == 'delete' || action == 'rescan' || action == 'Wake On Lan') {
                if(action == 'rescan' && window.proceed != 1){
                    event.preventDefault();
                    CustomAlert("<div style='display:block;float:right;'>This installation's licensed asset limit has been reached. Your Lansweeper license is limited to 2000 assets.<br>To resume scanning assets, please upgrade your license.<br>You can request an upgrade via <a href=\'https://www.lansweeper.com/pricing'>this page</a> or contact our sales team directly via <a href='https://www.lansweeper.com/contact-sales/' target = '_blank' >sales</a><br>We advise you to select ''I want to add assets or helpdesk agents to my license'' in the ''How can we help you today'' section.</div>", 'Licensed asset limit reached', '');
                }

                if (action != 'rescan' || window.proceed === 1) {
                    var message = 'Are you sure you want to ' + action + ' ' + counter + ' Asset(s) ?';

                    if (action != 'rescan') {
                        if (hasAzureRgSelected) {
                            message += '</br><img width="16" height="16" src="/images/warning.gif"/> Deleting an Azure Resource Group results in the removal of all associated VM\'s.';
                        }
                        if (hasAwsContainerSelected) {
                            message += '</br><img width="16" height="16" src="/images/warning.gif"/> Deleting an AWS EC2 VPC results in the removal of all associated instances.';
                        }
                    }

                    CustomConfirmdialog(message, function(dat)
                    {
                        if(dat) {
                            ShowLoading();
                            $.post(href, { "AssetIDS": JSON.stringify(tmprow) }, function(data) {
                                //completed
                                var text = counter + " Asset(s) are added to the queue.";
                                if (action === "delete") {
                                    var deleted = 0;
                                    $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem:checked").each(function(e) {
                                        var index = $(this).parent().parent().index() + 1;
                                        $("#appendbody2 tr:nth-child(" + (index - deleted) + ")").remove();
                                        deleted++;
                                    });
                                    $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem:checked").closest("tr").remove();
                                    //adjust totals - All Assets (30)
                                    window.realtotal -= deleted;
                                    window.total-= deleted;

                                    var lastpage = $("#pagesize").val() * window.currentpage;
                                    if (lastpage > window.total) lastpage = window.total;
                                    if (window.total <= $("#pagesize").val()) $("#totalassets").text("(" + window.total + ")");
                                    else $("#totalassets").text("(" + (((window.currentpage - 1) * $("#pagesize").val()) + 1) + "-" + lastpage + "/" + window.total + ")");

                                    //disable next page 
                                    if (window.currentpage * $("#pagesize").val() >= total) $("#nextp").addClass("disabled");
                                    else $("#nextp").removeClass("disabled");

                                    //Show deletion message
                                    if (hasAzureRgSelected || hasAwsContainerSelected) {
                                        var vmsDeleted = JSON.parse(data).ReturnValues["vmsDeleted"];
                                        counter += vmsDeleted;
                                    }
                                    text = counter + " Asset(s) are removed from the database.";

                                    $.get('/AssetActions.aspx?action=aboveassetlimit', function(data) {
                                        data = JSON.parse(data);
                                        if(data.Error) window.proceed = 0;
                                        else window.proceed = 1;
                                    });
                                }
                                CreateHead();

                                if (window.currentpage != 1 && ((window.currentpage - 1) * $("#pagesize").val()) >= window.total) {
                                    window.currentpage--;
                                    getReport();
                                }
                                else if(action === "delete") {
                                    getReport();
                                } else {
                                    CreateHead();
                                    HideLoading();
                                }
                                CustomAlert(text, "", "info");
                    }).fail(function(data) {
                         HideLoading();
                         CustomAlert(data.responseText, "Error", "error");
                            });
                        }
                        else return false;
                    });
                }
            }
            else {
                if(counter > 999) {
                    CustomAlert('Too many assets selected.', 'Alert', 'alert');
                }
                else {
                    if (action == "addtogroup") {
                        StandardDialog(href, "Add " + counter + " asset(s) to group", function (data) {
                            CustomAlert(counter + " Asset(s) have been added to the group(s).", "", "info");
                        }, "AddToGroup", tmprow);
                    }
                    else if(action == "assetfieldschange") {
                        StandardDialog(href, "Change asset field(s) - " + counter + " asset(s)", function (data) {
                            var dat = JSON.parse(data);
                            if(dat.Error) {
                                CustomAlert(dat.Emsg, "Error", "error");
                            }
                            else {
                                
                                    var statechange = false;
                                    if(counter > 30 || dat.AddedRows.length > 5) {
                                        statechange = true;
                                    }
                                    else {
                                        for(var i = 0; i < dat.AddedRows.length; i++) {
                                            if(dat.AddedRows[i][0] == 'State' || dat.AddedRows[i][0] == 'AssetName') {
                                                statechange = true;
                                                break;
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    if(!statechange) {
                                        for(var i = 0; i < dat.AddedRows.length; i++) {
                                            var index = $('#reptable2 thead th#col' + dat.AddedRows[i][0]).index() + 1;
                                            var assettypechange = -1;
                                            $('.chkrem:checked').each(function() {
                                                var td = $('#reptable2 tbody tr:nth-child(' + (parseInt($(this).parent().parent().index()) + 1) + ') td:nth-child(' + index + ')');
                                                switch(dat.AddedRows[i][0]) {
                                                    case 'Domain':
                                                        td.find('a').html(dat.AddedRows[i][1]);
                                                        td.find('a').attr('href', '/Report/report.aspx?det=Web50getdomain&title=Computers%20in%20' + dat.AddedRows[i][1].replace(/ /g, '%20') +'&@domain=' + dat.AddedRows[i][1].replace(/ /g, '%20'));
                                                        break;
                                                    case 'Model':
                                                        td.find('a').html(dat.AddedRows[i][1]);
                                                        td.find('a').attr('href', '/Report/report.aspx?det=web50findbymodel&@model=' + dat.AddedRows[i][1].replace(/ /g, '%20') + '&title=Model%20' + dat.AddedRows[i][1].replace(/ /g, '%20'));
                                                        break;
                                                    case 'Manufacturer':
                                                        td.find('a').html(dat.AddedRows[i][1]);
                                                        td.find('a').attr('href', '/Report/report.aspx?det=Web50findallbyvendor&@vendor=' + dat.AddedRows[i][1].replace(/ /g, '%20') + '&title=Computer%20vendor%20' + dat.AddedRows[i][1].replace(/ /g, '%20'));
                                                        break;
                                                    case 'AssetType':
                                                        $('#reptable2 tbody tr:nth-child(' + (parseInt($(this).parent().parent().index())  + 1) + ') td:nth-child(1)').html('<a href="/Report/report.aspx?det=Web50getdevicebytype&title=All%20' + dat.AddedRows[i][2] + '%20assets%20&@devicetype=' + dat.AddedRows[i][1] + '">' + dat.AddedRows[i][2] + '</a>');
                                                        assettypechange = i;
                                                        break;
                                                    default:
                                                        var divv = td.find('div');
                                                        if(divv.length > 0) divv.html(dat.AddedRows[i][1]); 
                                                        else td.html(dat.AddedRows[i][1]); 
                                                }  
                                                td.find('span').html(dat.AddedRows[i][1]);
                                            });
                                            
                                            if(assettypechange != -1) {
                                                $('.chkrem:checked').parent().next().find('img').attr('src', '/images/' + dat.AddedRows[assettypechange][3]);
                                            }   
                                        }
                                        $('#reptable2 tbody tr:first-child td').each(function() {
                                            if($(this).width() > colwidths[$(this).index()]) colwidths[$(this).index()] = $(this).width();
                                            else $(this).css('min-width', colwidths[$(this).index()] + 'px');
                                        });
                    
                                        CreateHead();
                                        CustomAlert("Edit fields completed.", "Info", "info");
                                    }
                                    else getReport("Edit fields completed.");
                                

                                return true;
                            }
                        }, "ChangeField(s)", tmprow);
                    }
                    else if(action == "addrelation") {
                        var founderror = false;
                        try {
                            $('#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem:checked').each(function() {
                                if ($(this).data('type') == 'Location') {
                                    founderror = true;
                                    throw "err";
                                }
                            });
                        }
                        catch(mm) {
                            CustomAlert("Locations can't have relations.", "", "error");
                        }
                        if(!founderror) {
                            StandardDialog(this.href, "Add relation - " + counter + " asset(s)", function (data) {
                            if(data != 'ok') {
                                CustomAlert(data, "", "error"); 
                            }
                            else {
                                CustomAlert("Relations have been added.", "", "info");
                            }
                        }, "AddRelation(s)", tmprow);
                        }
                    } 
                } 
            }    
        });

        $(document).on('click', '#selectUserForRelation', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();

    function sortping(rev) {
        var tr = $("#reptable tbody tr");
        var tr2 = $("#reptable2 tbody tr");
        $("#reptable tbody tr").remove();
        $("#reptable2 tbody tr").remove();
        if (rev) {
            //if reverse
            $.fn.reverse = [].reverse;
            $("#reptable2").append(tr2.reverse());
            $("#reptable").append(tr.reverse());

        } else {
            var toSort = tr.get();
            var toSort2 = tr2.get();
            for (var i = 0; i < toSort.length; i++) {
                toSort[i] = [toSort[i], i];
            }
            var sortedTr = toSort.sort(function (a, b) {
                switch ($(a[0]).children().first().children().first().attr("src")) {
                    case "/images/nok.png":
                        a = 2;
                        break;
                    case "/images/ok.png":
                        a = 1;
                        break;
                    default:
                        a = 3;
                        break;
                    }
                    switch ($(b[0]).children().first().children().first().attr("src")) {
                    case "/images/nok.png":
                        b = 2;  
                        break;
                    case "/images/ok.png":
                        b = 1;
                        break;
                    default:
                        b = 3;
                        break;
                }
                return parseInt(a) - parseInt(b);
            });
            var sortedTr2 = [];
            for (var j = 0; j < sortedTr.length; j++) {
                sortedTr2.push(toSort2[sortedTr[j][1]]);
                sortedTr[j] = sortedTr[j][0];
            }
            $("#reptable").append(sortedTr);
            $("#reptable2").append(sortedTr2);
        }
    }

    function CreateHead(arg) {

        if(arg == "scroll") fakeScroll = $('#fakeScrollBar').scrollLeft() - 1;

        var test = $("#reptablehead tr:first-child th");
        var colspan = "<colgroup id='clgroup'>";
        for (var i = 1; i <= test.length; i++) {
            var element = $("#reptablehead th:nth-child(" + i + ")");
            colspan += "<col width='" + element.outerWidth() + "' " + (element.css('display') === 'none' ? "style='display: none;'" : "") + "/>";
        }
        colspan += "<col width='100%'/>";
        colspan += "</colgroup>";

        var newhead = colspan + $("#reptablehead").formhtml();

        $("#newhead").remove();

        $("#reptablewrapper").append("<table  id='newhead' class='reporttable borderbot' width='" + parseInt($("#reptable").width() + 2) + "'  cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' >" + newhead + "</table>");
        $("#newhead").css("position", "fixed");

        var browser = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
        if(!/chrome/.test(browser) && !(browser.indexOf('firefox') > -1)) {
            $('#newhead #clgroup col:nth-child(' + ($(".colping").length === 0 ? 3 : 4) + ')').attr('width', typeof InstallTrigger !== 'undefined' ? '218px' : '217px');
        }

        //Scroll + resize
        $(window).scroll(function () {
            $('#newhead').css({ 'left': 0 - $(this).scrollLeft() });
            $('.menuleft').css({ 'left': 0 - $(this).scrollLeft() });
            $('#reptitle').css({ 'left': 0 - $(this).scrollLeft() });
            resetFieldEditor();
        });

        $('#reptablewrapper2').scrollLeft(0);
        test = $("#reptablehead2 tr:first-child th");
        colspan = "<colgroup id='clgroup'>";
        for (var i = 1; i <= test.length; i++) {
            var element = $("#reptablehead2 th:nth-child(" + i + ")");
            colspan += "<col width='" + element.outerWidth() + "'/>";
        }
        colspan += "<col width='100%'/>";
        colspan += "</colgroup>";

        var newhead2 = colspan + $("#reptablehead2").formhtml();
        $("#newhead2").remove();
        $("#reptablewrapper2").append("<table  id='newhead2' class='reporttable borderbot' width='" + $("#reptable2").width() + "'  cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0'>" + newhead2 + "</table>");
        $("#newhead2").css({"position":"fixed"});
        
        $('#newhead2').css({ 'left' : 0 + $('#newhead').css('width'), 'padding-left' : '2px' });

        $('#reptablewrapper2').scroll(function() {
            var left = $(this).scrollLeft();
            $('#newhead2').css('left', parseInt($('#reptable').css('width')) - left + "px");
            resetFieldEditor();
        });

        placeFakeScroll();
    
        $("body").keydown(function(e) {
            if(!$("#newhead2 .reportsearchfield").is(':focus') && !$("#newhead .reportsearchfield").is(':focus') && $('#fieldEditor').data('field') == '') {
                if(e.keyCode == 37) { // left
                    $('#fakeScrollBar').scrollLeft($('#fakeScrollBar').scrollLeft() -12);
                }
                else if(e.keyCode == 39) { // right
                    $('#fakeScrollBar').scrollLeft($('#fakeScrollBar').scrollLeft() + 12);
                }
            }
        });
    
        $(window).resize(function() {
            setTimeout(function() {
                placeFakeScroll();
                topBannersFix();
                
                    $('#navigationLeft').css('height', parseInt($(window).height()) - parseInt('90') - 16 + 'px');
                
            }, 100);
        });
    
        giveFocus();

        topBannersFix();
    }

        function ShowLoading() {
            $("#loadingDialog").show();
            $("#loadingDialog2").show();
        }
        function HideLoading() {
            $("#loadingDialog").hide();
            $("#loadingDialog2").hide();
        }
        (function($) {
      var oldHtml = $.fn.html;

      $.fn.formhtml = function() {
        if (arguments.length) return oldHtml.apply(this,arguments);
        $("input,button", this).each(function() {
          this.setAttribute('value',this.value);
        });
        $("textarea", this).each(function() {
          // updated - thanks Raja!
          this.innerHTML = this.value;
        });
        $("input:radio,input:checkbox", this).each(function() {
          // im not really even sure you need to do this for "checked"
          // but what the heck, better safe than sorry
          if (this.checked) this.setAttribute('checked', 'checked');
          else $(this).prop('checked', false);
        });
        $("option", this).each(function() {
          // also not sure, but, better safe...
          if (this.selected) this.setAttribute('selected', 'selected');
          else $(this).prop('selected', false);
        });
        return oldHtml.apply(this);
      };

      //optional to override real .html() if you want
      // $.fn.html = $.fn.formhtml;
    })(jQuery);
    
    function editCustom() {
        var element = $(this);
        var colElement = $('#reptable2 thead tr:first-child th:nth-child(' + (element.index() + 1) + ')');
        var childElement = ($(this).find('div').length > 0) ? $(this).find('div') : $(this);
        if ($('#fieldEditor').data('field') != element.attr('id')) {
            var values = (colElement.data('values') === undefined || colElement.data('values') === null) ? '' : colElement.data('values').split(',');
            resetFieldEditor();
            $('#fieldEditor').data('field', element.attr('id'));
            switch (colElement.data('type')) {
            case 2:
                $('#fieldEditor').html('<input id="fieldEditInput" class="fieldEditInput datepicker" name="value" autocomplete="off"; color: black; width: 80px;" value="' + childElement.html() + '"/>');
                $(".datepicker").datepicker({ dateFormat: 'mm/dd/yy', firstDay: '0' });
                break;
            case 1:
                $('#fieldEditor').html('<textarea id="fieldEditInput" class="fieldEditInput" name="value" maxlength="255" autocomplete="off" style="color: black; width: 150px; height: 100px;">' + childElement.html() + '</textarea>');
                break;
            case 3:
                $('#fieldEditor').html('<span style="background-color: white; float: left; width: 150px; height: 25px;"><input class="fieldEditInput" id="fieldEditInput" name="value" type="checkbox" style="color: black;" ' + (childElement.html() == 'yes' ? 'checked="checked"' : '') + '/></span>');
                break;

                }
                if (e.which == 27) {
                    resetFieldEditor();
                }
            });

            $('#fieldEditorBtn').bind('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAssetData(element);
            });

            $('#fieldEditorBtnC').bind('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                resetFieldEditor();
            });
        }
        else {
            resetFieldEditor();
        }
    }

    function resetFieldEditor() {
        $('.fieldEditInput').unbind('focusout');
        $('#fieldEditor').unbind('keydown');
        $('#fieldEditorBtn').unbind('click');
        $('#fieldEditorBtnC').unbind('click');
        $('#fieldEditor').html();
        $('#fieldEditor').css('left', '-9999px');
        $('#fieldEditor').data('field', '');
        $('#fieldEditor').attr('data-field', '');
     }

    function sendAssetData(element) {
        var childElement = (element.find('div').length > 0) ? element.find('div') : element;
        var colElement = $('#reptable2 thead tr:first-child th:nth-child(' + (element.index() + 1) + ')');
        data = ($('#fieldEditor').find('#fieldEditInput').val());
        if(colElement.data('type') == 5) {
            for(var i = 0; i < $('#fieldEditor div').children().length; i++) {
                if($('#fieldEditor div div:nth-child('+ i + ') input').is(':checked')) data = $('#fieldEditor div div:nth-child(' + i + ') input').val();
            }
        }

        if ((data.indexOf('>') != -1 || (data.indexOf('<') != -1))) {
            $('#fieldEditor #fielderror').remove();
            $('#fieldEditor').append('<label id="fielderror">HTML tags not allowed</label>');
        }
        
        else if((element.data('type') == 7 || element.data('type') == 8) && parseFloat(data.replace(',', '.')) != data.replace(',', '.')) {
                if($('#fielderror').length == 0) {
                $('#fieldEditor').append('<label id="fielderror">Invalid numeric value</label>');   
            }
            else $('#fielderror').html('Invalid numeric value');
        }
        else if(colElement.data('type') == 'ip' && data != '' && !data.match(ipregex)) {
            if($('#fielderror').length == 0) {
                $('#fieldEditor').append('<label id="fielderror">Invalid IP4 address</label>');   
            }
            else $('#fielderror').html('Invalid IP4 address');
        }
        else if(colElement.data('type') == 'mac' && data != "" && !data.match(macregex)) {
            if($('#fielderror').length == 0) {
                $('#fieldEditor').append('<label id="fielderror">Invalid MAC address</label>');   
            }
            else $('#fielderror').html('Invalid MAC address');
        }
        else {
            var tmprow = new Object();
            tmprow['data'] = colElement.data('type') == 3 ? ($('#fieldEditor').find('#fieldEditInput').is(':checked') ? 'on' : 'n') : data;
            tmprow['field'] = colElement.data('field');
            tmprow['type'] = colElement.data('type');
            tmprow['assetid'] = element.parent().attr('id');
            var childelementwidth = childElement.width();
            $.post('/AssetActions.aspx?action=editcustomfield',
                { "data": JSON.stringify(tmprow) })
                .done(function(ret) {
                    ret = JSON.parse(ret);
                    if (!ret.Error) {
                        switch (colElement.data('type')) {
                            case 3:
                                childElement.html($('#fieldEditor').find('#fieldEditInput').is(':checked') ? 'yes' : 'no');
                                break;
                            case 'state':
                                childElement.html($('#fieldEditor').find('#fieldEditInput option[value="' + data + '"]').text());
                                if ($('#fieldEditor').find('#fieldEditInput option[value="' + data + '"]').text() != "Active") {
                                    element.parent().addClass('lgr');
                                } else {
                                    element.parent().removeClass('lgr');
                                }
                                break;
                            case 'mac':
                                childElement.html(data.toUpperCase());
                                break;
                            case 'assettype':
                                childElement.html($('#fieldEditor').find('#fieldEditInput option[value="' + data + '"]').text());
                                $('#reptable tbody tr:nth-child(' + (element.parent().index() + 1) + ') td:nth-child(2) img').attr('src', '/images/' + ret.ReturnValue);
                                if (data == '-1') element.removeClass();
                                break;
                            case 10:
                            case 4:
                            case 12:
                            case 5:
                                childElement.html(data);
                                break;
                            default:
                                childElement.html(data.trim());
                                break;
                        }

                        resetFieldEditor();

                    	if (childelementwidth < childElement.width()) CreateHead('scroll');
                    } else {
                        if ($('#fielderror').length == 0) {
                            $('#fieldEditor').append('<label id="fielderror">' + ret.Emsg + '</label>');
                        } 
                        else $('#fielderror').html(ret.Emsg);
                    }
                });
        }
    }

    function giveFocus() {
        if(filterid != '') {
            if(filterid == 's1') el = $('#newhead #' + filterid);
            else el = $('#newhead2 #' + filterid);
            var elemLen = el.val().length;
            el[0].selectionStart = elemLen;
            el[0].selectionEnd = elemLen;
            el.focus();
            if(filterid != 's1') $('#fakeScrollBar').scrollLeft(el.position().left - 10);
            filterid = '';
        }
    }

    function placeFakeScroll()
    {
        // place scrollbar at end of page
        var scrolladjust = parseInt('256');
        $('#fakeScrollBar').css({ 'margin-left': parseInt($("#reptable").css('width')) + scrolladjust + "px" });
        $('#fakeScrollBar').css({ 'width': parseInt($(window).width()) - scrolladjust - parseInt($("#reptable").css('width')) + 'px' });
        $('#fakeScrollBar').html();
        $('#fakeScrollBar').html('<span><table style="white-space:nowrap"><tr>' + $("#reptable2 tbody tr:first-child").html() + '</tr></table></span>');
        $('#fakeScrollBar span table').css('width', $("#reptable2").css('width'));
        $('#fakeScrollBar').scroll(function() {
            $('#reptablewrapper2').scrollLeft($(this).scrollLeft());
        });
        $('#fakeScrollBar').scrollLeft(fakeScroll + 1);
    }

    jQuery.expr[':'].Contains = function (a, i, m) {
        return (a.textContent || a.innerText || "").toUpperCase().indexOf(m[3].toUpperCase()) >= 0;
    };

    function pingassets() {

        var isok = false;
        $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem:checked").each(function (key) {
            isok = true;
            return false;
        });

        if(isok) {
            $('#pinglink').attr("href", "#");
            $('#pinglink').addClass("disabled");
            $(".filtercol").attr("disabled", "disabled");

            if ($(".colping").length == 0) {
                //head
                $("#reptable thead tr:nth-child(2)").prepend("<th class='colpingth'><img style='margin-left: 3px;' width='16' height='16' src='/actions/tester.png' /></th>");
                $("#reptable thead tr:nth-child(1)").prepend("<th class='colpingth' data-sort='0'>Ping</th>");

                AdjustLastcolumn();
            }
        
            //pingers
            window.pingers = [];
            window.repingers = [];
            var counter = 0;
            $("#reptable tbody tr").each(function(key, value) {
                if ($(this).find('.chkrem').prop('checked')) {
                    if ($(this).find('.colping').length == 0) {
                        $(value).prepend("<td class='colping' width='10'valign='top'><img width='10' height='10' align='absbottom' class='pinger' rel='" + $(this).attr("id") + "' src='/images/indicator.gif' name='indi'></td>");
                    }
                    else $(this).find('.colping').html("<img width='10' height='10' align='absbottom' class='pinger' rel='" + $(this).attr("id") + "' src='/images/indicator.gif' name='indi'>");
                    if ($.inArray($(this).attr("id"), window.pingers) == -1) window.pingers.push($(this).attr("id"));
                    counter++;
                }
                else {
                    if ($(this).find('.colping').length == 0) {
                        $(value).prepend("<td class='colping' width='10'valign='top'></td>");
                    }
                }
            });
            $('.colping').css("display", "");

            CreateHead();

            $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false });
            window.pingassets.count = 0;
            window.pingassets.total = counter;
            $(window.pingers).each(function(key, value) {
                //alert($("#reptable tbody tr#"+value).length);
                PingAsset($("#reptable tbody tr#" + value + " .pinger"));
            });
        }
    
        else CustomAlert("No Assets selected.", "", "warning");
    }

    function PingAsset(asset) {
        var $asset = $(asset);
            

            $.ajaxSetup(({ cache: false }));
            
        var t= $.getJSON('/ping.aspx', { assetid: $asset.attr("rel") }, function (data) {
            window.pingassets.count += $asset.length;
            
             switch (data.Status) {
                        case 1: //online
                            $($asset).attr("src", "/images/ok.png");
                            break;
                        case 2: //offline
                            $($asset).attr("src", "/images/nok.png");
                            break;
                        case 3: //vproAMT
                            $($asset).attr("src", "/images/orange.png");
                            break;
                        default: //neutral response
                        $($asset).attr("src", "/images/neutral.png");    
                        }    

            $asset.className = $asset.className;//force faster redraw trick
            if (window.pingassets.count == window.pingassets.total) {
                if(window.repingers.length == 0) {
                    //check if really complete
                    $('#indi').css("display", "none");
                    $('#pinglink').attr("href", "javascript:pingassets()");
                    $('#pinglink').removeClass("disabled");
                    $(".filtercol").removeAttr("disabled");
                    window.pingers = null;
                }
                else {
                    window.pingassets.count = window.pingassets.count - window.repingers.length;
                    for(var i = 0; i < window.repingers.length; i++) {
                        PingAsset(window.repingers[i]);
                    }   
                    window.repingers = [];
                }          
            } else {
                //  PingAsset($('.pinger').eq(window.pingassets.count)); // ping next
            }  
        }).fail(function() {
            window.pingassets.count += $asset.length;
            repingers.push(asset);
            if (window.pingassets.count == window.pingassets.total) {
                window.pingassets.count = window.pingassets.count - window.repingers.length;
                    for(var i = 0; i < window.repingers.length; i++) {
                        PingAsset(window.repingers[i]);
                    }
                window.repingers = [];
            }
        });
        
        if(window.xhr == undefined)window.xhr = new Array();
        window.xhr.push(t);
    }

    function AdjustLastcolumn() {
        $("#reptable colgroup col:last-child").attr("width", $("#reptable colgroup col:last-child").attr("width") - 23);
    }

    function redirectToExport(hyperlink) {
        var tmprow = new Object();
        $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem:checked").each(function(key) {
            tmprow[parseInt(this.value)] = this.name;
        });

        $.post('/AssetActions.aspx?action=setassetsexport', { "AssetIDS": JSON.stringify(tmprow) }, function(data) {
            data = JSON.parse(data);
            if (data.Error) {
                CustomAlert(data.Emsg, 'Error', 'error');
            }
            else {
                var url = hyperlink;
                url += getAssetSearchParameters();
                window.location = url;
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).on('click', '.exportlink', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var element = $(this);

        $.post('/Export.aspx?action=checkIsAllowed', function(data) {
            data = JSON.parse(data);
            if (data.Error) {
                CustomAlert(data.Emsg, 'Error', 'error');
            }
            else {
                if (!data.ReturnValues.IsAllowed) {
                    CustomAlert(data.ReturnValues.Message, 'Exporting not allowed', 'warning');
                }
                else {
                    redirectToExport(element.attr('href'));
                }
            }
        });
    });
    
    function getSelectedAssets() {
            var tmprow = new Object();
            $("#reptable tbody tr:visible input.chkrem:checked").each(function (key) {
                tmprow[parseInt(this.value)] = this.name;
            });
            
            return tmprow;
        }

    $(document).on('click', '.executeNow', function(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            if(!$(this).is(".disabledBtn")) {
                if ("True".toLowerCase() == "true") {
                    var assets = getSelectedAssets();
                    var ids = new Array();
                    for(var id in assets)
                    {
                        ids.push(id);
                    }
                    var idString = ids.toString();
                    if(ids.length > 0) {
                        StandardDialog("/deployment/ScheduleActions.aspx?action=addConfig&source=assets&Assets="+idString, "Deploy", function (data) {
                            var r = $.parseJSON(data);
                            if (r.Error) {
                                $(".ui-dialog-buttonpane .verror").remove();
                                $(".ui-dialog-buttonpane").prepend("<div style='float: left;' class='verror' data-cy='errormessage'>  <span class='rred'>Error while saving:<br /> " + r.Emsg + "</span><br></div>");
                                return false;
                            } else {
                                return true;
                            }
                        },undefined, undefined, "Are you sure you want to deploy this package?");
                    }else if(ids.length == 0){
                        CustomAlert("You have no assets selected. Please select the assets you want to deploy on.", "No Assets Selected", "info");  
                    }
                } else {
                    CustomAlert("Provide an account with read-execute rights only on the shared folder.<br/>Using an administrator account is a severe security risk!<br/>This password will be accessible to all users. Click <a href='/deployment/packageshares.aspx'>here</a> to enter the details.", "Warning", "warning");
                }
            }
        });

    function getAssetSearchParameters() {
        var url = '';

        url += "&page=" + window.currentpage;
        url += "&top=" + $("#pagesize").val();
        url += "&order=" + window.sortdir;
        url += "&orderby=" + (window.sort === 0 ? 1 : window.sort);
        url += "&scanningissues=" + window.ScanningIssues;

        if ($("#newhead").length == 0) url += "&s1=" + encodeURIComponent($("#reptablehead input#s1").val());
        else url += "&s1=" + encodeURIComponent($("#newhead input#s1").val());
        for (var i = 2; i < 54; i++) {
            if ($("#newhead2").length == 0) url += "&s" + i + "=" + encodeURIComponent($("#reptablehead2 input#s" + i).length ? $("#reptablehead2 input#s" + i).val() : '');
            else url += "&s" + i + "=" + encodeURIComponent($("#newhead2 input#s" + i).length ? $("#newhead2 input#s" + i).val() : '');
        }
        url += "&s54=" + ($("#newhead2 select#s" + 54).val() == undefined ? '-1' : $("#newhead2 select#s" + 54).val());
        
        if ($("#newhead2").length == 0) url += "&s55=" + encodeURIComponent($("#reptablehead2 input#s55").val());
        else url += "&s55=" + encodeURIComponent($("#newhead2 input#s55").val());
        

        return url;
    }

    function checkCdrScanningInProgress() {
        clearTimeout(checkCdrScanningInProgressTimeout);
        $.get('/Assetactions.aspx?action=checkcdrscanninginprogress', function (data) {
            data = JSON.parse(data);
            if (data.ReturnValue === '0') {
                cdrScanningInProgress = '0';
                $('#cdrScanningInProgress').remove();                
                topBannersFix();
            }
            else {
                checkCdrScanningInProgressTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
                    checkCdrScanningInProgress();
                }, 30000);
            }
        });
    }

    function checkCdrHasInternetAccess() {
        clearTimeout(checkCdrHasInternetAccessTimeout);
        if ($('#addScanningCredentials').length > 0) {
            if ($('#addScanningCredentials').css('display') !== 'none') {
                $.get('/Assetactions.aspx?action=checkCdrHasInternetAccess', function (data) {
                    data = JSON.parse(data);
                    if (data.ReturnValue === '0') {
                        if ($('#addScanningCredentials #cdrNoInternet').length == 0) {
                            $('#addScanningCredentials td:nth-child(2)').append('<div id="cdrNoInternet">No Internet connection. Credential-free Device Recognition will not work as designed. Click <a href="https://www.lansweeper.com/knowledgebase/credential-free-device-recognition#troubleshooting%22" target="_blank">here</a> to resolve the issue.</div>');
                            topBannersFix();
                        }
                    }
                    else {
                        $('#addScanningCredentials #cdrNoInternet').remove();
                        topBannersFix();
                    }
                    checkCdrHasInternetAccessTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
                        checkCdrHasInternetAccess();
                    }, 30000);
                });
            }
            else {
                checkCdrHasInternetAccessTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
                    checkCdrHasInternetAccess();
                }, 30000);
            }
        }
    }

    $(document).on('click', '.infoBlockRefresh', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        window.location.reload();
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#addScanningCredentials .closeinfoblock', function () {
        showAddCredentialsBanner = '0';
        clearTimeout(checkCdrHasInternetAccessTimeout);
        $('#addScanningCredentials').remove();
        topBannersFix();
    });

    function topBannersFix() {
        if ($('#addScanningCredentials').length <= 0 && $('#cdrScanningInProgress').length <= 0) {
            $('#topBanners').remove();
        }
        let topBanners = $('#topBanners');
        var topBannersHeight = topBanners !== undefined && topBanners.length > 0 ? (parseInt(topBanners.height()) + 11) : 0;
        $('#reptablewrapper').css('margin-top', (topBannersHeight + 28) + 'px');
        $('#reptable2').css('margin-top', topBannersHeight + 'px');
        $("#newhead2").css('margin-top', topBannersHeight + 'px');
    }
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    var licenseIsFilledIn = true;
    var hasRights = '1';

    $(document).ready(function () {
        licenseIsFilledIn = getIsLicenseFilledIn();
        if (hasRights === '0' && !licenseIsFilledIn) {
            $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
            $('#emailCaptureModal_screen2').hide();
            $('#btnSubmitKey').hide();
            $('.errorBlock').hide();
            $('.errorBlock').next().hide();
            $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen4').show();
            $('#emailCaptureModal_screen4').show();
            $("#emailCaptureModal").css({ "min-height": "300px" });
            $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
            if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
                $('#firstrunOverlay').hide();
            }
        } else {
            if (!licenseIsFilledIn) {
                initiateUnlockArea($('#keyArea'), isValidLicense);
                if (!(typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun)) {
                    $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
                    if (!doesConnectionExist()) {
                        $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen2').show();
                        $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen1').hide();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        //dirty fix for jquery ui focus stealing bug
        if (window.jQuery && window.jQuery.ui.dialog) {
            setTimeout(function() {
                $(document).unbind("focusin.dialog");
            }, 500);
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '.submitKey', function(e) {
        // if valid license, remove overlay
        var license = $(this).parent().find('.keyArea').val();
        var container = $(this).parents("div").first();
        var errorBlock = container.find(".errorBlock");

        if (unlocked) {
            openActivationTab(activationUrl);
        }

        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            ShowLoading();
        }
        
        var valid = checkIsValidLicense(license, errorBlock);

        if (valid) {
            saveLicense(license);

            //Open tab when activationUrl is available
            licenseIsFilledIn = true;

            if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
                firstRunNextContinue();
            }
            else {
                location.reload();
            }
        }
        else {
            $(this).parent().find('fieldset').css('border-color', '#ff0000');
            $(this).parent().find('.keyArea').css('color', '#ff0000');
        }
        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            HideLoading();
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#btnContinue', function (e) {
        // remove overlay and continue the first run wizard
        $("#emailCaptureOverlay").remove();
        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            location.reload();
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#btnBackToLoginKey', function (e) {
        location.href = "/login.aspx?lo=1";
    });

    $(document).on('paste', '#keyArea', function () {
        $('.errorBlock').html('');
    });

    function doesConnectionExist() {
        var url = "https://lansweeper.azure-api.net/ls-instances/unlock";
        var success = false;
        $.ajax({
            type: 'GET',
            url: url,
            complete: function (response) {
                if (response.status !== 503 && response.status !== 0){ success = true;}
            },
            async: false
        });
        return success;
    }
</script>
